title: console: Notification Settings shows external members switches whose writes all answer 403
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing category: out-of-scope finding from the contract review of PR #35122 (card #34728, merged as c9b3f7a10e): nit F4, 6971590801 and 6975907450. It was deferred from that PR and had no carrier. Filed by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong

An external member (`org_external` identity, `external_default` baseline) can open the Account app's **Notification Settings** page. It shows them every switch, digest and quiet-hours control, but each write they try answers `403`, because `external_default` grants no write on `sys_notification_preference`. Nothing leaks: the read answers only their own effective cells. The page offers actions it then refuses.

## Scope

- Show the controls disabled, with a short reason, when the caller holds no create or edit grant on `sys_notification_preference`. Alternatively, hide the nav entry for such callers. Pick one when the card is taken, and record why.
- The decision comes from the framework's own permission answer for the caller. The page does not check identity names.

## Done when

- An `org_external` caller sees the page read-only (or does not see the entry), and no write is attempted.
- A member and an organization administrator see no change.
- A pin for each of the three personas.
